comparison_policy.baseline_role: LlamaParse is the requested reference baseline, not independent source truth; a difference can expose a baseline defect rather than a service defect.
comparison_policy.chart_table_polymorphism: A LlamaParse table item labelled only as chart is compared as a chart visual and excluded from business-table counts.
comparison_policy.component_decomposition: Type-family and nesting-only differences are reported as acceptable schema differences; missing/reordered user-visible content is classified independently.
comparison_policy.json_envelopes: Exact wire-schema parity is not required. Raw keys, paths, types, and nesting are inventoried, while functional classification uses normalized page, content, table, visual, and ordering projections.
comparison_policy.ocr_and_visuals: Non-scanned visual-origin OCR aggregation is a token proxy, not spatial source truth; proxy-only differences require page-region review.
comparison_policy.out_of_scope: Latency, CPU, memory, and exhaustive hardening are not measured.
comparison_policy.page_identity: Physical page association prefers service page_index; printed page labels are compared separately against LlamaParse page-number tokens.
comparison_policy.rendering: DOM checks compare semantic tags, text, grouping, tables, links, and meaningful layout tokens. PNG metrics are diagnostic unless viewport, fonts, theme, and renderer match.
comparison_policy.surface_independence: Standalone reference Markdown and page Markdown embedded in LlamaParse JSON can differ; each surface is compared independently.
